all.source_quote: Age should be between 16 and 59 years.

unmodelled.text: Must work in the unorganised sector (construction, street vending, domestic work, migrant work, etc.)
unmodelled.source_quote: Must be a worker in the unorganized sector (e.g., construction workers, street vendors, domestic workers, migrant workers, etc.).

unmodelled.text: Must not be a member of EPFO, ESIC or government-funded NPS
unmodelled.source_quote: Should not be a member of EPFO, ESIC, or NPS (government-funded).

unmodelled.text: Must be self-employed, home-based or a wage worker in informal work
unmodelled.source_quote: Should be a self-employed worker, home-based worker, or wage worker in informal employment.

unmodelled.text: Meant mainly for low-income workers (no strict limit is stated)
unmodelled.source_quote: Generally intended for workers with lower or unstable income (typically below Rs 15,000/month for certain linked schemes).

ambiguous: Source is a short summary by the Department of Information & Cultural Affairs on wb.gov.in, not the scheme's own guidelines
The income line is guidance ('generally intended'), not a firm limit

en.title: e-Shram Card
en.benefit: A 12-digit UAN card for unorganised workers that links to accident cover (PMSBY), pension (PM-SYM) and other schemes.
en.how_to_apply: Register free on the e-Shram portal or at a Common Service Centre with Aadhaar, its linked mobile number and bank details.
